headline: Gifts to schools, executive session on retirements, and school meal price changes.
summary: The board will review consent agenda items including gifts to the Adult Education CNA Program and Highland Elementary School, then hold an executive session on retirement acceptances. The board will also discuss the 2027-2028 meeting schedule and possible changes to school breakfast and lunch prices.
items: Student Board Representatives will not be present
Accept In-kind GIFT of Masonicare Health Center's assistance and support of the Wallingford Adult Education CNA Program - Value of $25,000.00
Accept Monetary GIFT donated to the Highland Elementary School Student Activities Fund from Trail of Terror LLC, c/o Mr. Wayne Barneshi - Value of $1,500.00
Items Removed from the Consent Agenda
ACES Governing Board Representative report - Michael J. Votto, Delegate & Caroline Raynis, Alternate to ACES
CABE Report - Rajan Doering, Delegate to CABE
Executive Session on Discussion of Acceptance of Retirement(s) pursuant to Connecticut General Statutes, Section 1-200(6)(a)
Discussion and Approval of Acceptance of Retirement(s)
Approval of Board of Education Schedule of Meetings for February 2027 - January 2028
Discussion and Possible Approval of School Breakfast and Lunch Prices for Elementary, Middle, High School Students, and Adults
Date of Next Meeting - Monday, August 24, 2026, Board of Education, 6:30 p.m.
location: Board of Education Conference Room, 4 Fairfield Boulevard, Suite 2, Wallingford
